purpose: Multi-round DEV-100 agent-space optimization of the FROZEN baseline form (owner rulings 2026-08-23 section 7.1: two-contact knowledge-conditioned decode with out-of-core retrieval/ranking and alpha-blend consumption -- the C3 policy chain). Preregistration docs/readiness/2026-08-23-dev100-campaign-preregistration.md. Round 0 starts from the M11 operating-point sweep's recommended cell and each later round adjusts knobs from the PRIOR round's scored results; gold opens scoring-side only after a round's arms complete, never in runtime. This fragment is the machine-readable campaign contract: knob table, arms, stopping rule, ceilings, and the pinned knowledge snapshot. It carries no promotion claim -- the tuned config's confirmatory reading happens later on DEV-500, one-shot, per the ladder.

kb_campaign_policy_chain.m11_pair_boundary_rationale: M11 operating-point sweep verdict: zero repairs as flown; its two missed repairs are captured by the blend layer at zero additional contacts.

kb_campaign_round0_knobs.derivation: M11 operating-point sweep recommended cell: +2/+1 over primary on BOTH exposed splits with zero correct-to-wrong on either; contiguous positive plateau alpha in [0.54, 0.65], so 0.60 sits mid-plateau rather than on a knife edge.

kb_campaign_arms.description: direct decode, one contact per sample, no knowledge
C3 alpha-blend: direct decode, then acquire, then evidence-conditioned decode; every contact carries the original speech packet

kb_campaign_stopping_rule.evaluation_moment: between rounds only, after every arm of a round has completed (runner seal-before-score); gold never enters runtime

kb_campaign_ceilings.one_shot_semantics: per ROUND attempt; no silent intra-round retry. The campaign exposure row stays open across rounds with per-round accounting appended until the stopping rule fires.

kb_campaign_per_round_discipline.resend_rationale: the pcorrf divergence lesson: each round records the server -np and one byte-identical prompt resend pair.
